svg.title: NOOR design sheet
svg.text: 40s · the lead · on screen every minute · shape idea: the upright rectangle
THE QUIET CAR · character design · v1
The badge sits dead centre: the
eye goes to it in every wide.
#1E1A19 low bun, one lock comes loose
well practised. Nothing reads as hiding at first.
Everything about her is aligned and pressed; her
arc is the rectangle softening (blazer open,
The strap is the most saturated thing in the
car under BASE light (in the brownout the car
owns every colour: the strap goes dark too).
Bag: carried like it's heavy; it's empty (Bea
clocks this). Low bun: the loose lock appears
after the emergency-handle beat and stays.
Lanyard comes off over the head in one pull;
build the strap long enough (approx. 90 cm loop).
